]

METHODS = ["naive_xcorr", "diff_xcorr", "threshold_onset", "perm_granger", "ty_granger"]

def get_method_sig(pair_data, method):
    fwd = pair_data.get("forward", {})
    m = fwd.get(method, {})
    if method in ("perm_granger", "diff_xcorr"):
        return m.get("significant_fdr", False)
    return m.get("significant", False)

def get_pair_label(p):
    return f"{p['canary']}->{p['downstream']}"

def is_forward_sig(pair_data, method):
    fwd = pair_data.get("forward", {})
    m = fwd.get(method, {})
    if method == "naive_xcorr":
        return m.get("significant", False) and m.get("peak_lag", 0) > 0
    elif method == "diff_xcorr":
        return m.get("significant_fdr", False)
    elif method == "threshold_onset":
        return m.get("significant", False)
    elif method == "perm_granger":
        return m.get("significant_fdr", False)
    elif method == "ty_granger":
        return m.get("significant", False)
    return False

# 1. Build null distribution: per-method FPR across all null pairs

null_pair_votes = []

for nf in NULL_DIRS:
    with open(nf) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    for p in data["pairs"]:
        pair_votes = 0

            sig = is_forward_sig(p, m)

    print(f"  votes={v}: {cnt}/{n_null_pairs} ({cnt/n_null_pairs*100:.1f}%)")

for m in METHODS:
